mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.7% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where UNRATE falls below 3.7%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite HOUST above 1.3 million, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where INDPRO remains below 103.0 for two months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% and FEDFUNDS above 5.0% indicate a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both HOUST > 1.25 million and RSAFS > 690,000 million, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200,000 in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressure
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 200,000 and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases where GDPC1 remains below 2.0% for two quarters, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
